concerns.text: FR-004 requires comparing the SYSTEM-GENERATED execution plan against the ground-truth plan, but no task implements the SUT/router plan generator (the spec's scope assumption says the unified router is 'simulated using a lightweight Python script'). T021 says 'compute translation errors against T007 ground truth' with no producer of the generated plan; query_instance.schema.yaml also requires a `sut_plan` field that no task writes. The translation-error metric has no producer, so FR-004/SC-002 cannot be satisfied as tasked.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T021 / contracts:execution_log.schema.yaml vs spec.md:FR-003 and Edge Case 2
concerns.text: FR-003 requires 'distinguishing between successful execution and timeout failures' and Edge Case 2 requires timeouts to be 'recorded as a timeout failure, counted as a latency outlier'. T021's column list and execution_log.schema.yaml have no `timeout_flag` column; `success_flag=0` conflates timeouts with other failures, silently dropping the distinction the spec mandates.

US-2 acceptance scenario 2 specifies processing 'a set of 100 high-complexity graph queries' and reporting their error rate against low-complexity queries. T025 only aggregates low (≤2) vs high (≥3) groups from the general run; no task fixes or verifies the 100-query graph-specific comparison set, so this acceptance criterion is dropped.

Edge Case 3 says the run must fail with a specific error code when cgroups throttling 'fails to apply correctly due to container permissions'. T016 instead falls back to RLIMIT with throttling_mode='time_only' and only aborts when NEITHER mechanism applies. The plan documents this fallback, but the tasks doc should state explicitly that the RLIMIT fallback is a sanctioned deviation from the literal Edge Case 3 wording (or the spec amended), otherwise an implementer cannot tell which constraint wins.

T004 lists the schemas to create/repair but the contracts directory also contains analysis_result.schema.yaml (per-group mean_delta_latency, segmented_regression fields) and gam_results.schema.yaml (LMM/Jonckheere-Terpstra) that no task produces output for; T018/T020 write different formats. These orphan contracts conflict with FR-005's ANOVA/ANCOVA requirement and should be removed or reconciled so tasks don't silently ignore active contracts.
